name: Add participants
description: Add logins to a season's roster in bulk -- a textarea, one per line or comma-separated, or a JSON array in `logins`. Each becomes a season_participants row, pinned to an account if that identity already exists and kept as a login until its first sign-in otherwise, so a cohort written before the term admits its members the moment they sign in. `provider` is any sign-in provider's slug, github by default. A login already live in the season is left as it is; one previously removed is re-added. The response is the season's participants list, each row saying whether it has resolved or is still waiting. The season-admin-only fragment gates it and hands down the season id.

body.detail: Give one or more logins in `logins`, as a JSON array or a comma- or newline-separated string.

tasks.name: Tell each pinned participant they are in
tasks.description: A notification is never part of the statement that decided the thing: its own continue_on_error write after it, reading the decision off the row.
